display.purpose: Single-moment headlines and the reflective/epigraph voice. Always serif, often italic.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase mono for dates, counts, and section eyebrows only — never prose.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: The one ambient card shadow used throughout the ivory theme, regardless of card importance.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus ring, tinted to the active theme/region's own color (this is the ivory-theme default tint).

motion.name: tap-scale-soft
motion.purpose: Gentle press feedback on buttons/chips/cards — varies per component, never a hard mechanical snap.

motion.name: panel-slide
motion.purpose: Slide-in transition for side panels (e.g. Brain Map belief detail).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width primary action button — the ivory theme's one emphasis color (Deep Charcoal Ink) carrying the weight, not a separate accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2A2621; color: #FBF8F2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 13px 18px; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: none; transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(42,38,33,0.14); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default translucent surface card resting on the warm-paper background — the ambient card-rest shadow is the only elevation treatment in the system.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,253,248,0.66); border: 1px solid rgba(42,38,33,0.08); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(120,105,80,0.10); } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(42,38,33,0.4); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; color: #2A2621; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped tag/filter chip; fills with a tinted color only when actively selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: #FBF8F2; color: #2A2621; padding: 6px 11px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(42,38,33,0.08); transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(42,38,33,0.14); outline: none; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input; border shifts to the theme's warn color on error, never the accent/primary ink.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(42,38,33,0.1); background: #FBF8F2; color: #2A2621; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2A2621; } .ds-input.ds-input-error { border-color: #a85a1a; }

components.name: Modernist Primary Button
components.description: Modernist-mode (named exception) button using the app's one true accent color, Signal Vermillion — only valid on Auth/Profile/Belief Map/Settings surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-modernist { background: #ec3013; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 13px 18px; min-height: 48px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; border: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-modernist:hover { background: #dd2b0f; } .ds-btn-modernist:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: Mindscape is a mental-health journaling app whose entire visual identity rests on one idea, stated directly in its own interface copy: the interface is quiet, the user's mind provides the color. The ivory canvas, restrained charcoal typography, and near-total absence of an accent hue are not minimalism for its own sake — they're a deliberate refusal to compete with the one thing that's actually supposed to carry color and life on screen: the person's own belief data, rendered as a 3D star field. Until that data exists or is tapped, the system itself stays almost monochrome on purpose. This is a direct rejection of the cold blue/white 'medical dashboard' look most mental-health software defaults to.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, paper-like, almost colorless by default — color is earned by real user data, not decoration
Serif italic for voice/epigraph moments, sans for interface, mono for small tracked labels
Soft, ambient, warm-tinted shadows — never sharp or state-driven
Generously sized, softly tactile components (48px tap targets, gentle 0.94-0.99 tap-scale)
The 3D belief star-field is the one true signature element and the app's actual color source

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: The ivory theme has exactly one hue (Deep Charcoal Ink) at varying opacity for every text, border, and emphasis need. Don't introduce a second color to signal state or hierarchy — opacity and weight do that job.

rules.name: The Voice-Switch Rule
rules.body: Serif italic means the app or user's own reflective voice. Sans means interface. Mono means data/metadata. Don't use serif for interface chrome or sans for a reflective/epigraph moment.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Don't add a second elevation tier for 'more important' cards — importance is expressed through typography and ink opacity, not a heavier shadow.

dos: Do keep the ivory theme to one hue (Deep Charcoal Ink) at varying opacity for all text/border/emphasis needs.
Do use the ambient warm-tinted card shadow consistently rather than inventing elevation tiers.
Do reserve serif italic for voice/reflective moments and keep interface chrome in Inter.
Do let the belief star field carry color and motion — keep everything else around it quiet by comparison.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color into the ivory theme to signal state — that's what Modernist mode is for, on its own separate screens.
Don't treat Modernist or dark-immersive mode as the system to extend elsewhere — they're deliberate exceptions for specific surfaces, not the default.
Don't add a sharp/cold 'medical dashboard' visual anywhere in the ivory theme — it's the system's explicit anti-reference.
Don't make cards' shadows heavier to signal importance; use ink weight/opacity instead.
